name: Delaware

laws.summary: Lets DTI create and enforce statewide technology policies and standards.
State public-accommodation nondiscrimination law cited by the DTI policy.

laws.cite: 28 C.F.R. Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web and mobile rule, 2024; dates extended by DOJ interim final rule 2026-04-20)
laws.summary: State and local governments must make web content and mobile apps conform to WCAG 2.1 AA.

policy_docs.title: DTI Enterprise Policy AC-DIG-001 Digital Accessibility Policy (effective 2023-01-30)
State of Delaware Digital Accessibility Policy page

applies_to: All State of Delaware public-facing digital assets, state employees and third-party vendors; the legislature, judiciary, school districts and local governments must follow it only as a condition of using state IT resources.

deadlines.what: Federal ADA Title II floor: public entities with population 50,000+ must meet WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24)
Federal ADA Title II floor: entities under 50,000 and special districts (extended from 2027-04-26)

requires: Keep a public accessibility statement linked from the state homepage, with department-level information
Staff and vendor training via the Delaware Learning Center
A Digital Accessibility Senior Manager runs the program and reviews the policy yearly
Departments submit standards conformance reports every year, including vendor components
mobile: explicit — the policy commits to WCAG 2.1 A/AA for websites and mobile applications.
procurement: Third-party vendors must comply; annual conformance reports include vendor-built components.
enforcement: Handled administratively through DTI's Digital Accessibility Senior Manager; no statutory remedy found.
notes: Only pages 1–4 of the six-page policy were read. The Digital Accessibility & Equity Master Plan was mentioned in search results but not opened. Federal floor: ADA Title II rule (WCAG 2.1 AA, web + mobile apps) applies to all state and local government regardless of state law; DOJ's 2026-04-20 interim final rule moved compliance dates to 2027-04-26 / 2028-04-26.

covers_conditionally.when: only as a condition of using state IT resources
